Definition: Timnah, the name of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Timnath or Timnah or Thimnathah = "portion"; 1) a town on the northern boundary of Judah later assigned to Dan; 2) a town in the hill country of Judah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
